# truenas_docker_network (Data Source)

Looks up a Docker network on TrueNAS by name (docker.network.query). Read-only: Docker networks are created/destroyed by Docker itself (and by installed applications), not by this provider — there is no corresponding truenas_docker_network resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Network name to look up (e.g. "bridge", "host", or an application's own network such as "ix-plex_default").

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Timestamp when the network was created.
- `driver` (String) Network driver type (e.g. bridge, host, null).
- `id` (String) Full Docker network identifier.
- `ipam` (Attributes) IP Address Management configuration for the network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipam))
- `labels` (Map of String) Metadata labels attached to the network (e.g. the owning application's Docker Compose project labels).
- `scope` (String) Network scope (e.g. local, global, swarm).
- `short_id` (String) Shortened Docker network identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--ipam"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipam`

Read-Only:

- `config` (Attributes List) Subnet/gateway pools allocated to this network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipam--config))
- `driver` (String) IPAM driver (e.g. "default").

<a id="nestedatt--ipam--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipam.config`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String) Gateway address for the subnet.
- `ip_range` (String) Allocatable IP range within the subnet, if narrower than the full subnet.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet in CIDR notation.
